_comment: Contract §21: generative mutation over critical changed code — policy, auth/session + jwt, schema/migrate, storage/state. Gate: zero UNCLASSIFIED survivors and zero timeouts in critical code (not a coverage %). Survivors are triaged against equivalent-mutants.json (two-person review + AST diff). Timeouts count as `timeout`, never `killed`. Score + timeouts are published; the baseline may not fall.
